name: CPE Technology Berhad
overview: 2026年，CPE Technology Berhad 通过子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购物业和机器以扩大精密加工产能，并与 Kanekita Co., Ltd. 成立合资公司，进入钝化处理技术的新业务。同时，公司完成全资子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 的自愿清盘，退出该休眠业务。
overview_en: In 2026, CPE Technology Berhad expanded its precision machining capacity through the acquisition of properties and machineries by its wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd., and entered into a joint venture with Kanekita Co., Ltd. to venture into passivation treatment technology. Meanwhile, the company completed the member's voluntary winding-up of its wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd., exiting that dormant business.

segments.name: 精密加工零件与组件
segments.note: 今年通过收购物业和机器扩大产能，并成立合资公司进入钝化处理技术领域。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment expanded capacity through property and machinery acquisitions and established a joint venture to enter passivation treatment technology.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM14,500,000 收购物业。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired a property for RM14,500,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 以 RM10,000,000 现金收购物业。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired a property for a cash consideration of RM10,000,000.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购机器。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired machineries.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 子公司 Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. 收购机器。
actions.text_en: Subsidiary Champion Precision Technology Sdn. Bhd. acquired machineries.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 Kanekita Co., Ltd. 签订股份购买与合资协议，成立合资公司制造和销售采用钝化处理技术的材料/产品，主要面向半导体行业。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Share Purchase and Joint Venture Agreement with Kanekita Co., Ltd.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成一家休眠子公司的自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: This year, completed the member's voluntary winding-up of a dormant subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 于2026年7月7日举行最终会议结束自愿清盘，清盘人最终会议报告已于2026年8月10日提交，预计三个月后完全解散。
actions.text_en: Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. held its final meeting on 7 July 2026 to conclude its member's voluntary winding-up; the Return by Liquidator was lodged on 10 August 2026, and the company will be fully dissolved after three months.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 全资子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 启动成员自愿清盘，该公司自2019年11月1日起休眠。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. commenced member's voluntary winding-up; the company has been dormant since 1 November 2019.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资公司进入采用钝化处理技术制造和销售材料/产品的新业务，主要面向半导体行业的集成气体供应系统精密组件。
model_changes.text_en: Entered into a new business of manufacturing and selling materials/products utilizing passivation treatment technology through a joint venture company, primarily for precision components of integrated gas supply systems in the semiconductor industry.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 退出休眠子公司 Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. 的业务（机械零件和组件服务），该公司自2019年起无运营。
model_changes.text_en: Exited the business of dormant subsidiary Champion Oil Tool Sdn. Bhd. (services for parts and components of machineries), which has been inactive since 2019.
